records.title_verbatim: Higher Nitec in Automotive Engineering (2 YEARS)

modules.title_verbatim: Workplace Safety, Health & Environment
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to apply Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) policies, Environmental Management System procedures and practices in the planning, preparation and execution of work activities to ensure a safe and reliable workplace environment.

modules.title_verbatim: Data & Digital Essentials
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to prepare data for analysis, use online tools for collaborative work and maintain information security when online.

modules.title_verbatim: Engine Technology
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to service fuel, lubrication, cooling and air intake system components in petrol and diesel engines.

modules.title_verbatim: Chassis & Drivetrain Technology
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to service and replace automotive drivetrain and chassis components, including the manual transmission clutch and brakes, on a vehicle.

modules.title_verbatim: Chassis & Drivetrain Systems
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to repair and rectify faults within automotive chassis and drivetrain systems

modules.title_verbatim: Automotive Electrical & Electronic Technology
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to interpret, measure, and identify faults in vehicle auxiliary systems, including the starter, charging, and lighting systems.

modules.title_verbatim: Automotive Electrical & Electronic Systems
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students Should be able to perform functional checks on engine electrical and auxiliary electrical systems by conducting diagnosis, troubleshooting and rectifying faults using manufacturer service manuals and accurately interpret electrical wiring diagrams.

modules.title_verbatim: Engine & Powertrain Management
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to use systematic fault-finding techniques to identify faults in engine systems, as well as service engine mechanical components and the emission control system.

modules.title_verbatim: High Voltage Vehicle System & Safety
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be equipped with the knowledge and skills necessary to understand, work with, and ensure the safety of high voltage electrical systems in automotive engineering.

modules.title_verbatim: Vehicle Telemetry Systems
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to diagnose communication faults within the vehicle communication system using diagnostics tool and perform remote vehicle monitoring.

modules.title_verbatim: Automotive Body & Chassis Diagnosis
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to interpret diagnostic results and rectify faults on vehicle steering include SRS Airbag braking and transmission systems on petrol- or diesel-powered vehicle as well as service alternative powered vehicle’s powertrain.

modules.title_verbatim: Control & Driver Assistance Systems
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of this module, students should be able to perform fundamental assessment on the status and performance of the vehicle stabilisation control systems and advanced driver assistance systems. They will be equipped with the skills and knowledge to perform diagnosis and calibration of the systems using appropriate diagnostic tools and equipment.

modules.title_verbatim: Automotive Powertrain Diagnosis
modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of the module, students should be able to use systematic fault-finding techniques to diagnose and identify issues in the engine drivetrain and electrical systems. They will be equipped with skills in using On-Board Diagnostic equipment to rectify faults in the vehicle’s powertrain systems.

records.institution: Ceylon German Technical Training Institute (CGTTI), Moratuwa
records.entry_as_published: Age: Between 16 & 22 years. Education: Passed 06 subjects at the G.C.E. (O/L) Examination including Sinhala/Tamil language (Medium of Instruction) and Mathematics in one sitting.

modules.title_verbatim: Basic Training at CGTTI: Building Foundations for Excellence
Training in Automobile section via cutaway models and computer based simulators, dismantling and assembling of units and subunits of motor vehicles
Engine: History of Automobile, Tools and Equipments, Workshop Safety, Type of Engines and related parts, Fuel Supply System (petrol, diesel gas), Starting System.
Chassis: Clutch, Manual Gearbox, Front & Rear Axles, Assembling of Brake system (pneumatic & hydraulic), Steering System, Suspension System.
Auto Electrical: Starting System, Electric System, Charging System, Battery maintenance.

Production training in heavy vehicles at Chassis section. (Overhauling and assembling of Clutch, Automatic and Manual gearboxes, Differential, Front axle, Rear axle, Manual and Power assisted steering, Wheel & Tyres, Suspension)
Chassis, Clutch, Conventional Gearbox, Propeller Shaft and Joints, Brake, Steering. – (04 Months)
Production training in Engine Section. (dismantling, inspection, overhauling and assembling of Diesel Engines and Fuel Injection Pumps, timing, mounting and testing)
Parts of the Engine, Engine Assembling, Cooling and Lubrication Systems, Repairing sub units (cylinder head, water pump, oil pump, oil filter and oil cooler) – (04 Months)
Production training in light vehicles at Vehicle Repair Section (running repairs, servicing, Emission testing. overhauling of engine, transmission, brake and suspension)
Intake Air System, Exhaust System, Carburettor, Wheel Alignment – (02 Months)
Training in Automobile Electronics Training Section via simulators, EFI, ABS, SRS, Vehicle Stable Control System and fault diagnosing by using Auto Scanners.
Electronic Ignition System, Fuel Injection System, Emission Control, Common Rail Electronic Diesel Supply System. – ( 02 Months )
Training in running repairs on buses belongs to Sri Lanka Central Transport Board (SLCTB) Omnibus Depots – 06 Months
Training in running repairs on light and heavy vehicles at state organizations and private companies – 06 Months
Revision and Final Evaluation

Theory: Theoretical lessons on workshop science, workshop calculation & technical drawing are conducted one day per week during the course. In addition English language classes are conducted for trainees.
